name: Navidrome plugin
summary: A plugin on the Navidrome side, rather than Tapedeck polling it from outside. Navidrome is already supported as a polled source today; this is the tighter integration. The deck's half shipped in v0.125.0 — a source can be put into plugin mode, which mints the plugin a token and stops polling that source in the same move, and listens from it are stored as the server's own so cover art and the library pages work. The Navidrome-side plugin is what remains.
adds: Push instead of poll, the transcoding decision, and metadata the Subsonic surface doesn't expose
